name: 97216 · Portland, OR
findings: ZIP 97216 (Portland) has 88 nonprofit organizations. 51 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 43 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (51% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97216 (Portland) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
